entries.name: Enhancement Vigor
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced maximum health. Grants at +4/+16/+20 per base-type track. Powers a steady HP boost across the enhancement ladder, doubling the effect at the highest tiers.

entries.name: Enhancement Edge
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced attack power. Grants at +8/+20 per base-type track. Provides clean flat damage scaling without compounding against existing affixes.

entries.name: Enhancement Aegis
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced shield grant. Grants at +12/+20 per base-type track. Omni element reflects the universal defensive intent; tier progression delivers meaningful incremental shield capacity at major enhancement breakpoints.

entries.name: Enhancement Quicken
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced action speed. Optional milestone for base types with mobility focus. Increased op keeps scaling proportional — a faster character stays relatively faster even after enhancement.

entries.name: Enhancement Keen
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced critical chance. Optional milestone for base types emphasizing precision builds. Low power band reflects that crit rate's resolver-point scale (sigmoid) means small nominal increases compound meaningfully.

entries.name: Enhancement Fortify
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced percentage health scaling. Sibling to enhance-vigor's flat approach; offers a different growth curve for base types where multiplicative HP scaling fits the fantasy better. Triggers at higher enhancement levels (typically +16+) where percentage multipliers compound meaningfully.

entries.name: Enhancement Savagery
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced percentage attack scaling. Sibling to enhance-edge's flat approach; provides a secondary damage avenue for base types with exceptional attack scaling identity. Trivial power band keeps percentage gains sensible at low tiers where many base types start enhancement.

entries.name: Enhancement Hardy
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced armor/damage reduction. Grants raw defense independent of shield mechanics. Useful for base types that emphasize passive mitigation over active shielding, providing a distinct defensive identity at high enhancement tiers (+12 and beyond).

entries.name: Enhancement Recovery
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced healing grant on trigger. One-time or grant-triggered heal distinct from ongoing regeneration; provides a survival boost without competing with the continuous recomposition of max-HP enhancements. Typically granted mid-ladder (+8+) on sustain-focused bases.

entries.name: Enhancement Evasion
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced dodge chance. Resolver-point scale means low power band translates to meaningful percentage chance. Pairs with armor enhancements to offer a full defensive tree — one base type might stack hardy+evasion across enhancement levels for layered mitigation.

entries.name: Enhancement Swift
entries.notes: Milestone family for enhanced movement speed, granted along the enhancement track for base types built around repositioning and lane control. The Increased op keeps the gain proportional to the base type's own starting speed, so a naturally mobile base type stays comparably faster after enhancement rather than converging toward a flat baseline.

entries.name: Enhancement Resilience
entries.notes: The core essence of the unit hardens, allowing it to withstand sudden impacts with greater composure.

entries.name: Enhancement Vitality
entries.notes: A surge of life essence that bolsters the physical vessel against the coming storm.

entries.name: Enhancement Prowess
entries.notes: The base type's innate combat instincts sharpen, allowing for more devastating strikes when momentum is high.

entries.name: Enhancement Might
entries.notes: The base essence of the entity swells with raw, unbridled power.

entries.name: Enhancement Bloom
entries.notes: The essence of the plant surges outward, manifesting as a protective layer of energy upon emergence.

entries.name: Enhancement Zenith
entries.notes: A sudden surge of peak performance that pushes the unit beyond its natural limits. This milestone marks the moment a plant reaches its absolute potential.

entries.name: Enhancement Girth
entries.notes: The structural integrity of the core thickens, allowing it to withstand greater physical strain.
